subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should OpenClaw accept Gateway/provider-backed editable composer dictation as a core Control UI feature now, or keep this work inside the broader WebChat voice planning thread?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with Control UI ergonomics, but it creates a new authenticated microphone-to-Gateway STT path with provider-routing and security-boundary implications that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Review the linked Gateway-backed PR as canonical
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the candidate implementation and require proof plus review fixes before landing.

options.title: Defer to the broader voice tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open but route final UX decisions through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 before merging a standalone dictation path.

options.title: Reject core dictation for now
options.body: Close this direction only if maintainers decide editable dictation should not live in the core Control UI surface.

recommendation.title: Review the linked Gateway-backed PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the candidate implementation and require proof plus review fixes before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the prior server-side dictation implementation and has the strongest feature-history signal for this exact Gateway/UI boundary.
